# Contributing to EventFlow

EventFlow uses documentation-first, traceable development.

Before significant implementation:

1. Confirm the requirement exists in the PRD.
2. Determine whether an ADR is required.
3. Review architecture/database/API/security/UX impact.
4. Implement on a scoped branch.
5. Test the change.
6. Update applicable documentation.
7. Pass release gates before tagging a release.
